requirement.description: The hook_http2 function in the HTTP/2 hook module is incomplete and does not properly intercept HTTP/2 requests to create and store HTTP2Record objects in the records collection. All tests in test_hook_h2.py are failing with "len() == 0" indicating no records are being created.
requirement.contract: The hook_http2 function must properly intercept HTTP/2 requests made via httpx library and create HTTP2Record instances that are added to the HTTPRecords collection. Specifically: 1. Intercept httpx client methods (get, post, put, delete, etc.) for both sync and async clients 2. Create HTTP2Record instances with proper initialization including URL, method, and protocol 3. Add these records to records.requests dictionary with unique IDs 4. Ensure proper metadata tracking (initiator, group, etc.) 5. Handle both successful requests and exceptions properly
requirement.acceptance: The test case tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2 should pass, confirming that 1 HTTP2Record is created and stored in records.

requirement.description: The current hook_http2 implementation only sets up decorators but doesn't actually capture the request/response data needed for HTTP2Record objects to be properly populated.
requirement.contract: The hook_http2 function must properly capture HTTP/2 request and response data and populate HTTP2Record instances with: 1. Request details (URL, method, headers, content) 2. Response details (status code, headers, content) 3. Protocol information (HTTP/2) 4. Proper timing and metadata
requirement.acceptance: The test case tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_request should pass, verifying request data capture.

requirement.description: The hook_http2 function doesn't properly handle the async nature of httpx.AsyncClient methods, which are essential for full HTTP/2 support.
requirement.contract: The hook_http2 function must support both synchronous and asynchronous httpx client methods: 1. Handle sync httpx methods (get, post, put, delete, etc.) 2. Handle async httpx methods (get, post, put, delete, etc.) with async hooks 3. Ensure proper context management for both cases
requirement.acceptance: The test case tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_asyncclient should pass, confirming async support.

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record creation logic in hook_http2 is fundamentally flawed - it creates records but doesn't properly link them to the HTTPRecords system.
requirement.contract: The hook_http2 function must properly integrate with the HTTPRecords system by: 1. Creating HTTP2Record instances with correct constructor parameters 2. Setting up proper relationships between records, initiators, and groups 3. Ensuring records are stored in the records.requests dictionary 4. Setting protocol property to "HTTP/2" for all created records
requirement.acceptance: The test case tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_response should pass, verifying proper record population.

requirement.description: The hook_http2 function doesn't support multiple concurrent requests or sessions which are tested in several test cases.
requirement.contract: The hook_http2 function must handle multiple concurrent requests and sessions properly: 1. Support multiple requests within the same session 2. Support multiple requests across different sessions 3. Maintain proper record separation between different request contexts 4. Handle both client and server-side HTTP/2 tracking when enabled
requirement.acceptance: The test cases tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_many_requests and tests/test_hook_h2.py::test_h2_client_many_requests_session should pass, confirming multi-request support.
